jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 782 authorizes the Dresden School District (the Hanover-Norwich Interstate School District) under the New Hampshire-Vermont Interstate School Compact. 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) lists SAU 70 (the district's New Hampshire administrative unit) in the Northeast CESA rather than Dresden itself.
SAU 70 (official site administering the Dresden district).

sources.note: Dresden Articles of Agreement (December 17, 2002, as reproduced in the Town of Norwich Selectboard packet of June 10, 2020), Article C: the Dresden board 'shall consist of eleven (11) members, seven (7) of whom shall be residents of Hanover and elected by the Hanover School District, and four (4) of whom shall be residents of Norwich and elected by the Norwich Town School District' -- directors are deemed elected to Dresden by their election to the member-district boards; the person elected to Norwich's two-year seat in even-numbered years sits on the Dresden board with 'all the rights of a member... except the right to vote'. The compact permits at-large seats (16 V.S.A. sections 774, 775) but Article C provides none. The seven Hanover (New Hampshire) seats are OUT OF SCOPE for this dataset (Walter's ruling, 2026-10-22) and no post is modeled for them; the Norwich seats are modeled here, and no separate Norwich School District board post is built.

Town of Norwich official ballot tallies: March 3, 2026 -- 'For DRESDEN-NORWICH SCHOOL DIRECTOR, three years': Lisa Christie 798 and Michael K. Costa 754 elected (terms to 2029); 'For NORWICH SCHOOL DIRECTOR, two years': Garrett Palm 796 re-elected (to 2028). March 4, 2025: Gina C. des Cognets elected (806, to 2028). March 5, 2024: Neil Odell elected (1,027, to 2027). The five are the Norwich side of the Dresden board per SAU 70's Annual Report 2025-26 officers list.
